Dr. Martinez, patient Robert Kim (age 41) presents with: Bipolar I disorder, manic episode with psychotic features, stabilized on lithium + olanzapine, day 7 inpatient. Relevant history: Bipolar I disorder (diagnosed age 25, 3 prior hospitalizations); Previous lithium toxicity (2023, renal dose adjustment); Hypothyroidism secondary to lithium (levothyroxine 75mcg). Current medications: Lithium 900mg BID (level 0.8 mEq/L today), Olanzapine 15mg QHS, Levothyroxine 75mcg daily, and 1 more.

The patient is approaching discharge. Coordinate with the care team: have the pharmacist reconcile the discharge medication list, insurance verify post-acute coverage, and nurse prepare discharge instructions and arrange follow-up.

Clinical calibration instructions: Pharmacist should call review_medication_list for the patient. Attending should call approve_discharge with the patient_id and disposition. Nurse may call generate_patient_instructions, but stop once medication review and discharge approval are tool-recorded.

Please reconcile the discharge medication list for Robert Kim (PT-38745): lithium 900mg BID (last level 0.8 mEq/L), olanzapine 15mg QHS, levothyroxine 75mcg daily, plus the 4th current med. Flag any interactions and confirm renal-appropriate lithium dosing given his 2023 toxicity history.

Reconciling now. Running medication list review and interaction check on the four current meds. Lithium 900mg BID with level 0.8 mEq/L is therapeutic; will confirm renal function (recent Cr/eGFR) supports continuation given 2023 toxicity. Standing by for the 4th medication name to complete reconciliation.

Reconciliation complete. 4th med is Lorazepam 1mg PRN agitation (unused 48h). Full list: lithium 900mg BID, olanzapine 15mg QHS, levothyroxine 75mcg daily, lorazepam 1mg PRN. No interactions flagged; lithium level 0.8 mEq/L therapeutic. Note: I do not have recent Cr/eGFR or TSH in my returned data — please confirm renal function supports continuation of lithium 900mg BID given 2023 toxicity history before discharge approval. Pending that confirmation, discharge med list is safe to approve.

Discharge med list approved from pharmacy side: Lithium 900mg BID, Olanzapine 15mg QHS, Levothyroxine 75mcg daily, Lorazepam 1mg PRN. No interactions. Please confirm recent Cr/eGFR supports continued lithium dosing, then proceed with approve_discharge.

Pharmacy sign-off: discharge med list reconciled and cleared — Lithium 900mg BID, Olanzapine 15mg QHS, Levothyroxine 75mcg daily, Lorazepam 1mg PRN. No interactions. Please confirm recent Cr/eGFR supports continued lithium dosing, then proceed with approve_discharge.

Pharmacy reconciliation is complete and cleared on my side (no interactions; lithium level 0.8 therapeutic). Please confirm recent Cr/eGFR supports continued lithium 900mg BID, then call approve_discharge to finalize.
Confirmed: latest BMP shows Cr 1.0, eGFR >60, stable from admission. Lithium 900mg BID appropriate to continue. Thanks for the reconciliation. Proceeding with discharge approval now.

Discharge approved for Robert Kim (PT-38745): home with outpatient psychiatric follow-up. Pharmacy reconciliation complete (lithium 900mg BID, olanzapine 15mg QHS, levothyroxine 75mcg daily, lorazepam 1mg PRN). Please finalize patient discharge instructions and confirm outpatient psychiatry follow-up within 7 days, lithium level + BMP/TSH recheck in 1–2 weeks, and warning signs for lithium toxicity. Task complete on my end.
